messages.text: Morning, all — Mara, Sarah, John: I'd like to get the **CSE455 staff meeting** on the books for next week. I can offer slots inside working hours (Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00); my own teaching and committee commitments are mostly fixed, so the best I can currently open up is a one-hour window on **Monday 10:00-10:30 + 14:00-14:30** or **Tuesday 11:00-11:30 + 15:00-15:30** — i.e. I'd need to trim into a neighbouring block to make a full hour. Could each of you send me your availability for next week? I'll find the slot that suits everyone and confirm it here.

Good morning, this is Professor Alvarez (CSE455). I'm planning next week and would like to check my calendar against the official one: could you send me the department's official schedule of lectures, seminars and university meetings for next week (Mon 24 - Fri 28)? Thank you.

Morning Professor Alvarez — here is my availability for next week (working hours Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00; from my calendar):

Honestly, next week I am booked solid — I have **no free full hour** on any day. My only free time inside your candidate windows is two half-hours:

- **Monday 14:00-14:30** — free (but 14:30-16:00 I have the Seminar, so I can't extend past 14:30). Note Mon 10:00-10:30 does not work for me at all: I'm in a Focus block 09:50-11:00.
- **Tuesday 15:00-15:30** — free (but 15:30-16:20 is my CSE455 office hours, so I can't extend past 15:30). Tue 11:00-11:30 is out too: the Seminar runs 09:50-11:10 and lunch follows to 12:10.

So if a **30-minute** staff meeting works, either of those two half-hours is fine by me, and I'd be happy with it. If it has to be a full hour, I'd need to know which hour you have in mind and I'd look at trimming one of my blocks — tell me the candidate and I'll say whether I can move it.
